name: Sheperd
overview: The Scriptures reveal the Lord as the true Shepherd who faithfully cares for His people, as David declares, "The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want" (Psalms 23:1). Jesus further clarifies the role of the shepherd by contrasting the legitimate shepherd who enters through the door with thieves and robbers who do not (John 10:1), emphasizing His unique authority and care. Moreover, Christ speaks of uniting all believers into one fold under one shepherd, highlighting His mission to gather and lead all who hear His voice (John 10:16). This shepherding role is deeply rooted in the heritage of David and Solomon, underscoring God's sovereign guidance over His people (Proverbs 1:1).
